basic_details.job_title: Madras University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Madras University has officially released the Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 notification for 1 vacancy in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Eligible candidates with a Ph.D. in Zoology, aged up to 65 years, can submit their offline applications up to 31 July 2026 through the prescribed application form available on the official website, https://www.unom.ac.in/. Selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis with a monthly salary of Rs. 30,000.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Madras University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-07-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Madras University Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Guest Faculty position at Madras University is 31st July 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Zoology to be eligible for the Guest Faculty position at Madras University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty position is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Guest Faculty position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. Candidates should download the application form, fill it correctly, and send it along with required documents via post to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty role at Madras University will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Guest Faculty position at Madras University is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the links provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What documents do I need to submit with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates, as specified in the official notification.
